gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Noto Sans Grantha reads smoothly, its tall little letters never snagging on a pinched bowl. College hits hard with flat, contrast-free strokes, while Noto Sans Grantha stays low in contrast and easy underneath.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Noto Sans Gujarati has curved strokes that stop before turning inward, leaving generous openings in its tall a, e and s. College is the one for punch with its uniform strokes; the body just reads.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-: Large lowercase strokes and terminals cut back to leave a wide gap make Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi feel open and modern on the line. College adds a stencil-like, constant-weight punch above it.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Tongs-like terminals, pointing outward, give Noto Sans Gurmukhi a crisp, tidy look with ascenders that barely rise above the x-height. And College's strokes, bent like cable with no swelling or thinning, make that tidiness feel even more deliberate.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Noto Sans Hanunoo reads easily, with lowercase filling most of the height and open terminals. And College does the loud work, its zero-contrast strokes carrying authority, while the body simply keeps the text moving.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Noto Sans Hebrew reads with a dominant midsection that swallows the line's height and wide gaps between curve ends and stems. And College handles the shouting, its glyphs looking cut from equal-width strips, while the body keeps things moving.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-hk: Chunky and uniform, College looks cut from one thick marker line, with terminals ending exactly as wide as they began. Noto Sans HK handles the reading, lifting brush-like ends away before each curve closes.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-imperial: College's strokes are as plain as a stitched thread outline, with no thick and thin at all. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic brings the approachable side, its c opening like pincers and capitals sitting just above lowercase.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-inscript: Blunt and uniform, College sets a dynamic tone while Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian opens big eyes on every e and a, sitting in a deep middle band. The heading shouts; the body simply keeps up.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-jp: Authoritative in feel, College holds its lines at a constant thickness, and Noto Sans JP follows with a very tall x-height and curves that sweep open. One drives the page, the other carries it.
